relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental unconditionally overrides the iterator's containment mode to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX for size estimation, regardless of the caller's requested flags. For the PoC polygon, the OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode produces an undercount because it lacks the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check that CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING has.

The cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon line-intersection check in iterStepPolygonCompact only fires when mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING, excluding CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX. Since maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental forces OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode for size estimation, boundary-crossing cells are not counted by the fine-grained check. The OVERLAPPING_BBOX fallback block at line 519 uses a coarser bbox-based approximation that can miss cells. The fix adds mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX to this condition, ensuring the size estimate is a superset of what any mode can produce.

polygonToCellsExperimental iterates with the caller's actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING mode, which includes the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check and finds more cells than the OVERLAPPING_BBOX-based size estimate predicted. When i reaches 3 (the allocated sz), this 8-byte write lands 0 bytes past the end of the 24-byte heap buffer, triggering ASAN heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8.

edges.description: The CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX value (3) assigned to iter._flags at polyfill.c:759 in maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental propagates as the mode variable at polyfill.c:511 via FLAG_GET_CONTAINMENT_MODE(iter->_flags).
